semantic.sqlgolden.enriched_validator_la.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    b1_root_j1.validator_index AS validator_index,
    sum(amount) AS GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
  FROM `dbt`.`int_GBCDeposit_deposists_daily` AS b1_root
  LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`int_consensus_validators_labels` AS b1_root_j1 ON b1_root.withdrawal_credentials = b1_root_j1.withdrawal_credentials
  GROUP BY b1_root_j1.validator_index
)
SELECT
  validator_index,
  GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
FROM branch_1
ORDER BY validator_index ASC
LIMIT 50

semantic.sqlgolden.micro_enriched_sector.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    day AS day,
    b1_root_j1.sector_name AS sector_name,
    sum(txs) AS bench_txs
  FROM `dbt`.`api_bench_txs_daily` AS b1_root
  LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`dim_bench_sectors` AS b1_root_j1 ON b1_root.sector_id = b1_root_j1.sector_id
  GROUP BY day, b1_root_j1.sector_name
)
SELECT
  day,
  sector_name,
  bench_txs
FROM branch_1
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 100

semantic.sqlgolden.micro_ratio_day.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    day AS day,
    sum(fees_usd) AS bench_fees,
    sum(txs) AS bench_txs
  FROM `dbt`.`api_bench_txs_daily` AS b1_root
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
  day,
  bench_fees,
  bench_txs,
  branch_1.bench_fees / nullIf(branch_1.bench_txs, 0) AS bench_fee_per_tx
FROM branch_1
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 100

semantic.sqlgolden.multi_branch_0dim.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    sum(net_usd) AS bridge_flow_netflow_daily
  FROM `dbt`.`int_bridges_flows_daily` AS b1_root
),
branch_2 AS (
  SELECT
    sum(amount) AS GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
  FROM `dbt`.`int_GBCDeposit_deposists_daily` AS b2_root
)
SELECT
  branch_1.bridge_flow_netflow_daily AS bridge_flow_netflow_daily,
  branch_2.GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value AS GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
FROM branch_1
CROSS JOIN branch_2
ORDER BY bridge_flow_netflow_daily DESC
LIMIT 1

semantic.sqlgolden.multi_branch_date.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    date AS date,
    sum(net_usd) AS bridge_flow_netflow_daily
  FROM `dbt`.`int_bridges_flows_daily` AS b1_root
  GROUP BY date
),
branch_2 AS (
  SELECT
    date AS date,
    sum(amount) AS GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
  FROM `dbt`.`int_GBCDeposit_deposists_daily` AS b2_root
  GROUP BY date
),
keys AS (
  SELECT date FROM branch_1
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT date FROM branch_2
)
SELECT
  keys.date AS date,
  branch_1.bridge_flow_netflow_daily AS bridge_flow_netflow_daily,
  branch_2.GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value AS GBCDeposit_deposists_daily__amount_value
FROM keys
LEFT JOIN branch_1 ON keys.date = branch_1.date
LEFT JOIN branch_2 ON keys.date = branch_2.date
ORDER BY date ASC
LIMIT 100

semantic.sqlgolden.single_metric_having.sql:
WITH
branch_1 AS (
  SELECT
    bridge AS bridge,
    sum(net_usd) AS bridge_flow_netflow_daily
  FROM `dbt`.`int_bridges_flows_daily` AS b1_root
